description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for checking repository version checks and git directory configurations. It defines test cases and functions to validate repository configurations and behaviors, primarily related to git properties and extensions.

methods.name: check_allow
methods.description: Checks if the repository allows certain configurations by verifying the git directory and core repository format version.

methods.name: check_abort
methods.description: Ensures that the git command fails when expected, indicating an invalid or misconfigured repository.

methods.name: mkconfig
methods.description: Creates a mock git configuration with specified repository format version and extensions for testing.
